invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.21.0 preserves Parts 1–23 and adds Part 24 backend safeguards without weakening the locked reference standard: company-scoped retry-safe invoice creation uses a canonical SHA-256 request hash and committed response ledger, concurrent duplicate creates serialize on one idempotency key, stale draft edits are rejected after a row lock using the invoice revision timestamp, existing payment and settlement idempotency/locking remains intact, and the retry ledger is included in the immutable audit boundary without storing the submitted invoice payload.
